name: @mwillbanks/elysia-mcp-adapter
description: Expose Elysia HTTP routes, prompts, and resources through a native-feeling MCP adapter.
author: Mike Willbanks

scripts.examples:build: bun run --cwd examples/apps-vanilla build && bun run --cwd examples/apps-react build
scripts.examples:typecheck: bun run --cwd examples/tasks typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/auth typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/apps-vanilla typecheck && bun run --cwd examples/apps-react typecheck
scripts.examples:test: bun run --cwd examples/tasks test && bun run --cwd examples/auth test && bun run --cwd examples/apps-vanilla test && bun run --cwd examples/apps-react test
scripts.examples:smoke: bun run --cwd examples/tasks smoke && bun run --cwd examples/auth smoke && bun run --cwd examples/apps-vanilla smoke && bun run --cwd examples/apps-react smoke
